en: I've just arrived in London. It's all new to me.
We've had nothing but nasty crimes lately.
Honestly, it's just more pointless legwork.
help out at all, it'd make my job much easier.
note: Cut follows #891 (slice 011), which must end like 'If only the townsfolk would form a watch, or'.

en: I seem to have gotten a little lost...
Hello, Constable Colin.
You must have it hard every day. Thank you.
Pickpockets, burglars, the Ripper...
Whatever it is, you're certainly hardworking.
Honestly, I wish crime would just
note: joined directly with #970 on one line

en: vanish from the face of the earth.
Then I wouldn't have to do any work.
It's a misunderstanding! I'm not suspicious.
It's my first time in London. I'm sorry.
What is it? Seen a suspicious man, have you?
If you ask me, you look suspicious yourself.
I'm a lazy sort by nature. When it's this busy,
note: #951 (slice 011) continues: 'I just get sick of everything.'

en: Who's there?
Out at this hour? Suspicious
It's me
Oh,
note: Colin: 'Oh, {NAME}, it's you.'; variant 'Oh,' for Claude msg 72382, where a line break follows.

en: What on earth do you want with me
If you fought alongside me, couldn't you
note: Player to Colin (stern recruiting scene, msg at 0x780a).

en: do your duty as an officer far better?
Wh-what are you talking about?
Agh
More
I need power.
Enough to stop him...
Power
, my master, I'll do
anything you command
Argh, dammit, that hurts!
My whole body aches. What the hell is this?
, my master... Your orders...
Hey, don't these bars look kinda bent to you?
Maybe I open 'em at night and slip out. Haha!
Hey, mate. Hey, I'm talkin' to you.
Oi, you there, mate! Yeah, Mr. Sharp Dresser!
M-A-T-E! Hey, you handsome devil!
What is it?
Heh heh heh, finally looked my way, eh?
So ya won't look unless somebody flatters ya?
I'm Patrick, London's top model prisoner.
Ya came all this way, so tell me your name.
You this rude to everybody else too?
You'll never get the ladies like that. Tsk, tsk.
I'm always behind these bars, so come again.
Hm? My, what a sharp-lookin' visitor.
Oh, it's you. Some hour to come callin'.
Hm? What's up? Wanna borrow my brains?
Well, if ya come round about this time,
it suits me fine. I got a schedule, sorta.
See ya. I got nothin' to do, so come again.
Hm? You're back again?
Don't tell me you've taken a likin' to the place?
London City Office, how may I help you?
We accept any and all citizen complaints.
...Get it? That's me doin' the shitty mayor.
Yo, it's you.
As ya see, I'm on duty again. Open for biz.
What can I do for ya, good customer?
<Why are you in prison?>
<How many years have you been here?>
Theft, that's what. S-T-E-A-L-I-N-G.
Pretty cute charge, huh? Just a petty thief.
'For my family,' as they say. A tearjerker, huh?
5 years, I guess.
note: no used_in; bytecode: answer to #1023 is box '#1027 / #1028 / #1029' after branch op 02 00 0d (talk.py drops #1027).

en: I was a fool at first, see. Broke out lotsa times.
Thing is, breakin' out adds to your sentence.
Gets me thinkin' about my family a bit.
Wonder if they've forgotten all about me
Yo. It's you.
Y'know, I get outta here pretty soon.
But I'm kinda scared. Bet my family's run off.
Maybe they don't need a guy like me now
Hard times or not, I never shoulda stolen.
Maybe we shoulda just stayed poor together.
I'm real worried, y'know.
Even once I'm out, will I manage?
